phase_name: Interactive Workflow + Publication Application/Transport Boundary Implementation
recommended_next_phase: 145G -- Interactive Workflow CLI Command Implementation. This recommendation does not authorize 145G.
summary: Implements the internal Interactive Workflow + Publication application-service boundary (src/pcae/interactive_workflow/application/) connecting the already-implemented, already-frozen persistence components (FilesystemSessionRepository, Phase 145D; FilesystemPendingReadinessStore, Phase 145E) to the Publication subsystem (PublicationCoordinator, Phase 144C), exactly per IWPC-001 v1.1. SessionApplicationService coordinates SessionCoordinator/SessionRepository (create/load/persist/update/completion). PublicationApplicationService coordinates the Pending-Readiness Store, the Session Repository (via SessionApplicationService, never a second parallel path), and PublicationCoordinator: readiness-package persistence idempotent-by-session_id (IWPC-REQ-024), publication-request preparation with disposition/staleness checks, a publication hand-off delegating authorize/execute to PublicationCoordinator unchanged (IWPC-REQ-127/128), attempt-linkage/disposition recording back into the Pending-Readiness Store (IWPC-REQ-087-089), and a resume_publication recovery entry point that re-reads persisted state rather than trusting a caller-supplied resume flag (IWPC-REQ-156). A new closed application-level error taxonomy (application/errors.py, 18 leaf classes under ApplicationServiceError) translates every underlying persistence/coordinator exception, carrying only session_id/package_id/record_id and a pre-sanitized message. Directly addresses IWPC-001 v1.1 IWPC-REQ-006's 'Model D' transport-neutral-application-service question, disclosed Non-Blocking (Phase 145A's stated risk of an unauthorized competing transport boundary does not apply, since no CLI/transport package exists yet for this layer to diverge from). One further disclosed Non-Blocking gap: resume_publication's replay path cannot recover a missing record_id after the specific IWPC-REQ-154 interruption window without depending on PublicationRecordStore directly, which this phase's dependency scope deliberately excludes (only PublicationCoordinator's public interface is an allowed dependency, IWPC-REQ-174). No CLI command, transport adapter, or engineering execution capability was implemented; no IWC-001/PEC-001/CHGR-001/IWPC-001 contract text was changed; SessionRepository, FilesystemSessionRepository, FilesystemPendingReadinessStore, SessionCoordinator, WorkflowOrchestrator, PublicationHandoff, and PublicationCoordinator were not modified. See docs/PHASE_145F_INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_PUBLICATION_APPLICATION_TRANSPORT_BOUNDARY_IMPLEMENTATION.md.

verdict: INTERACTIVE WORKFLOW + PUBLICATION APPLICATION/TRANSPORT BOUNDARY IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE -- implemented SessionApplicationService and PublicationApplicationService exactly per IWPC-001 v1.1, coordinating FilesystemSessionRepository (145D) and FilesystemPendingReadinessStore (145E) with PublicationCoordinator (144C) without reimplementing, bypassing, or duplicating any of their authority-bearing decisions. A new closed application-level error taxonomy translates every underlying exception without leaking raw filesystem paths, exception class names, or tracebacks. 45 new tests, zero regressions independently reproduced against the unmodified main baseline. Zero CLI/transport implementation, zero contract text change, zero runtime change, consistent with this phase's own Explicit No-Go. Two disclosed Non-Blocking findings (the IWPC-REQ-006 'Model D' question, and resume_publication's record_id recovery gap after the IWPC-REQ-154 interruption window) are documented in the phase report rather than silently resolved or hidden.
